name: LiquidBlob
description: Organic morphing vector shape driven by smooth SVG path and border-radius keyframe interpolation with zero external assets and graceful mobile degradation.
a11yNotes: Marked aria-hidden='true' on the decorative SVG/organic geometry and freezes path morphing when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

propsApi.name: morphSpeed
propsApi.description: Duration in seconds for one organic morph cycle.

propsApi.name: size
propsApi.description: Diameter in pixels of the organic form.
